verdict.rationale: The OpenAPI index page lists "All OpenAPI Files for v2026-06-15", so Gusto's Embedded Payroll API is versioned by date. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support windows, which is half of what the story asks for. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version support/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
